text:
tara_writer: Quick sync — I'm doing a cross-repo pass to standardize naming around service "routes" vs "endpoints" and a couple glossary gaps. Posting a proposed minimal rule set and a migration checklist so we can coordinate PRs.

kevin_devex: thanks — can you drop the rule set here? want to make sure SDK snippets align.

tara_writer: Proposal: 1) Use `route` for API surface in user-facing REST/HTTP docs (examples, SDKs). 2) Use `endpoint` when talking about infra/networking (load balancers, target groups). 3) Add glossary entries for both and a note about synonyms. 4) Update existing code examples to use `route` in client calls.

maria_docs: +1 for keeping client-facing docs consistent. small ask: add a short rationale line in the style guide so future writers know why.

sam_engineer: question — do we canonicalize on singular or plural? e.g., `route` vs `routes` in titles/headers.

tara_writer: good call. rule: singular for concepts/titles ("Route"), plural for lists and APIs ("Routes API" / "list routes"). I'll add that.

jen_prod: how many files are we talking? can we do a single PR that does search/replace + tests or break into per-section PRs?

tara_writer: estimate ~40 pages across docs + ~10 SDK snippets. prefer breaking into smaller PRs by area: docs core, SDK snippets, tutorials. I'll open a meta PR to track progress.

kevin_devex: I'll take SDK snippets for python/js. can you list the filenames/paths you plan to change so I can grep?

tara_writer: Sure — initial grep I ran:```
cd docs
rg "\bendpoint(s)?\b" --line-number | rg -v "infra|load balancer"
```
That gave me a shortlist. I'll paste full list in the meta PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/456

maria_docs: Suggest adding a changelog entry under docs style so customers see copy-only updates in release notes?

jen_prod: yes please — marketing prefers a single bullet in the next patch release.

sam_engineer: CI note: when you rename in SDK snippets make sure we run unit tests that import those snippets. some snippets are used in doctest harness.

ci-bot: PR #456 opened by tara_writer — build started.

kevin_devex: quick sed snippet for in-repo edits (use with care):```
# preview changes
rg "\bendpoint(s)?\b" docs | sed -n '1,200p'
# apply replace for user-facing files
git ls-files docs | rg "docs/(api|guides|tutorials)" | xargs sed -i "s/\bendpoint\b/route/g"
```

maria_docs: I'll draft the glossary entries and the style rationale paragraph. planning to add this under docs/style/terminology.md.

tara_writer: Assigning tasks: - tara_writer: meta PR + docs core edits - kevin_devex: SDK snippets (python/js) - maria_docs: glossary + rationale paragraph - sam_engineer: CI/doctest check + sample infra caller updates - jen_prod: coordinate release note blurb

jen_prod: ping me when the meta PR is merged, I'll slot the blurb. :thumbsup:

kevin_devex: starting work on js snippets — will open PRs grouped by SDK. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria_docs: draft in progress, will post in thread for a quick review.

ci-bot: PR #456 build passed.

tara_writer: awesome — if no major objections I'll merge the meta PR and we can land small follow-ups. final question: do we want redirects for any permalinks if we change header slugs?

maria_docs: only a couple of titles will change; I'll add redirects in the same PRs where applicable.

sam_engineer: noted — I'll also run a linkcheck after changes.

tara_writer: thanks all. I'll merge the tracking PR and post the breakdown. leaving this thread open for quick updates.

kevin_devex: thx — will post the first SDK PR link here.

maria_docs: posted glossary draft: short, neutral rationales + examples. feedback welcome.

jen_prod: closing loop: added release blurb draft to #marketing board.

tara_writer: merged tracking PR 456 — starting individual PRs now. :rocket:
